zh.bodyHtml:
各位猛将，好久不见！

距离上一次正式与大家同步消息，已经过去了较长一段时间。很抱歉让大家久等了，也感谢大家一直以来，对我们的关注。工作室目前仍在继续开发和维护游戏，当然我们也知道这件事应该由我们更及时地告知大家。

再次向所有一直以来等待和关注我们的大家表示感谢！谢谢大家一直以来的关注与包容。

今天想向大家介绍的，是即将登场的两位新猛将：张任与魏延。他们各自会有一段相遇剧情，以及对应的招募方式，奥义等，也需要不同的挑战，才会成为你的伙伴。

川中枪神·张任

张任是赵云的师兄，人称“川中枪神”。败尽川中好汉后，他与两位战友结伴来到中原，在邺城附近摆下擂台，等待中原群雄前来应战。

玩家达到一定声望等级后，前往邺城会触发张任剧情，随后开启擂台挑战玩法。与张任等人对战六场并获得胜利后，就可以将三位猛将收入麾下。

张任奥义——锋矢连环

益州骁将年少熟习的破阵之法。

先以三矢攒射挫敌锐气，再乘势突进挥刃横扫，令阵前敌手浮空昏眩，难复招架之力。

孤胆骑兵·魏延

魏延天性孤傲，对因循守旧的老派豪强嗤之以鼻。他总会出现在乱世风云的最前沿，既是要磨炼自身的实力，又是想寻得一位真正的明主。

玩家在挑战第五、六、七场战役的时候会触发魏延乱入剧情。接受他的挑战，并在至少两次对决中获得胜利后就可以获得这位猛将的认可和追随。

魏延奥义——奇谋奔袭

以一身胆气尽付奔袭，突进之际劈出十字刀光重创敌阵，得手之后即刻抽身后撤，不恋片刻鏖战。

移动端页面开放

除此之外，还有一项进展，我们也想在这里和大家说明：《猛将三国》移动端页面现已开放，目前我们也在同时进行移动端的相关筹备与测试。

我们预计将在今年内，开启一次移动端的测试招募，待招募方式与具体的时间都确认后，我们会另行发布消息，若您对此感兴趣，也非常欢迎您关注我们的后续公告。

这次久未发声，我们理解大家会有疑问，也感谢仍在关注游戏的各位猛将。也欢迎大家体验本次更新，并告诉我们你对新武将的感受。后续有确定的进展，我们也会尽快告知大家，再次感谢大家的等待与关注！

en.title: Zhang Ren and Wei Yan Are Here!
en.summary: Greetings, mighty generals! It’s been a while! It’s been quite some time since our last official update, and we’re sorry to have kept you waiting. Thank you for continuing to follo…
en.bodyHtml:
Greetings, mighty generals! It’s been a while!

It’s been quite some time since our last official update, and we’re sorry to have kept you waiting. Thank you for continuing to follow and support us. Our studio is still working on developing and maintaining the game, and we recognize that we should have kept you informed more regularly.

Once again, thank you to everyone who has continued to wait for news and follow our work. We truly appreciate your patience and understanding!

Today, we’d like to introduce two new mighty generals: Zhang Ren and Wei Yan. Each has their own encounter story, recruitment method, and Secret Art. You’ll need to overcome different challenges before they can join your ranks.

The Spear God of Shu · Zhang Ren

Zhang Ren is Zhao Yun’s senior fellow disciple, known as the “Spear God of Shu.” After defeating the local heroes of Shu, he and two companions traveled to the Central Plains. They set up an arena near Yecheng, waiting for warriors from across the region to challenge them.

Once you reach a certain Reputation level, travel to Yecheng to trigger Zhang Ren’s story and unlock the Arena Challenge mode. Win all six matches against Zhang Ren and his companions to recruit all three mighty generals.

Zhang Ren’s Secret Art — Linked Arrowhead Formation

A formation-breaking technique mastered by a young warrior of Yi Province.

He begins by firing three arrows in quick succession to break the enemy’s momentum, then surges forward and sweeps his blade across the battlefield, launching enemies into the air and leaving them stunned and unable to defend themselves.

The Lone Cavalier · Wei Yan

Proud and fiercely independent, Wei Yan has little patience for the old guard and their outdated ways. He is always at the forefront of the chaos engulfing the land, seeking both to hone his own abilities and to find a true lord worthy of his loyalty.

Wei Yan will appear unexpectedly during the fifth, sixth, and seventh battles. Accept his challenge and win at least two of the duels to earn his recognition and recruit him to your side.

Wei Yan’s Secret Art — Cunning Raid

He pours all his courage into a lightning-fast assault, charging forward and unleashing a cross-shaped slash that devastates the enemy ranks. Once he has struck, he immediately retreats, never lingering for a prolonged fight.

Thank you for your continued patience and support! We’d also love to hear about your experiences in the game. If you encounter any issues while playing, please let us know on Discord. We’ll continue to keep an eye on your feedback.

zh.bodyHtml:
大家好，我们刚刚推送了一个安装包。主要是针对可能会影响大家游戏体验的问题进行了调整与修复，当前版本号为ver_2.5.4 ，您可在游戏菜单左上角查看。

优化内容

  • 优化战斗加载逻辑，大幅提升战斗加载速度。 

  • 优化在Steam Deck设备上进行游戏时的操作体验。 

修复内容

  • 修复部分存档在更新版本后出现的铭刻武将、自定义武将数据丢失的问题，更新版本后，存档中丢失的武将数据将会被找回。 

  • 修复使用手柄进行操作时，舌战小游戏中鼠标光标未能正确显示的问题。 

特殊说明： 

关于战斗加载速度：因加载逻辑的关系，每次开启游戏后首次加载战斗仍需一定加载时间。后续其他战斗的加载速度将有显著提升。 

关于存档数据恢复：丢失数据的恢复是依据现有存档的数据进行的。若某些武将并未在存档中出现，则该武将数据将存在无法被读取和恢复的可能。这是由于我们工作失误所引起的BUG，在此，我们表示万分抱歉！！！

若您发现还有其他存档异常情况，请在群里联系管理员【1032486977】，我们来帮助您协调解决。我们一定会在后续的版本开发过程中会进行更加细致全面的测试，杜绝此类事件的发生。

en.title: ver_2.5.4 Patch Notes
en.summary: Hello everyone, we have just released a new update package. This update mainly includes adjustments and fixes for issues that may affect the gameplay experience. The current versio…
en.bodyHtml:
Hello everyone, we have just released a new update package. This update mainly includes adjustments and fixes for issues that may affect the gameplay experience. The current version is ver_2.5.4, which can be checked in the top-left corner of the game menu.

Improvements

  • Optimized the battle loading logic, significantly improving battle loading speed.

  • Improved the gameplay experience when playing on Steam Deck devices.

Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where engraved generals and custom generals data could be lost in some save files after updating. After updating, the missing general data in the save files will be restored.

  • Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor was not displayed correctly in the Debate mini-game when using a controller.

Additional Notes

Battle Loading Speed:
Due to the loading logic, the first battle after launching the game may still require some loading time. Subsequent battles will load significantly faster.

Save Data Recovery:
The recovery of missing data is based on the information currently stored in the save file. If certain generals were not present in the save data, there is a possibility that their data cannot be read or restored. This issue was caused by our development oversight, and we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

If you encounter any other save-related issues, please contact us via Discord or email. We will help coordinate and resolve the problem. We will also conduct more thorough testing in future updates to prevent similar issues from occurring again.

The current version is ver_2.4.8, which you can check in the top-left corner of the in-game menu.

【Bug Fixes】

  • Fixed an issue where background music could pause automatically under certain conditions

  • Fixed an issue in the Noble Clan quest “Bandit Suppression” where directly destroying the bandit camp could prevent the quest from progressing

【Improvements】

  • Improved system notifications when resources are missing after creating custom Workshop mods

  • Adjusted reward drops for Patriarch battles

  • Rebalanced stats for certain armor pieces to better match their intended levels

  • Improved story presentation in the Zhang Liao and Guan Yu character biographies

Thank you for all your suggestions and feedback.

If you encounter any issues during gameplay, feel free to contact us on Discord. We’ll continue to monitor and improve the game.

en.title: [Major Update] Zhang Liao & Guan Yu DLC Now Available
en.summary: Warriors, thank you for your patience! The free major DLC is now officially live! This update includes two expansion packs—Three Kingdoms Mushouden: Guan Yu Chronicle and Three Kin…
en.bodyHtml:
Warriors, thank you for your patience!

The free major DLC is now officially live! This update includes two expansion packs—Three Kingdoms Mushouden: Guan Yu Chronicle and Three Kingdoms Mushouden: Zhang Liao Chronicle (featuring red-tier weapons), along with a brand-new gameplay system available across all modes: Subdue Generals.

Meanwhile, Three Kingdoms Mushouden is still participating in the Steam Winter Sale. Both the Standard and Deluxe Editions are now available at 20% off. If you enjoy Three Kingdoms–themed games and character progression, now is a great time to jump in.

Update Highlights:

Three Kingdoms Mushouden: Guan Yu Chronicle

  • Exclusive Equipment:Crescent Dragon、Martial Might、Eternal Glory

  • New Ultimate Skill: Peerless Loyalty

※ Exclusive equipment and ultimate skills are obtained and learned through the main story

  • New Skin: Martial Saint

Includes character illustration / combat model / overworld appearance

Three Kingdoms Mushouden: Zhang Liao Chronicle

  • Exclusive Equipment:Wrath of Valor、Heaven’s Favor、Annihilator

  • New Ultimate Skill: Howl of the Azure Wolf

※ Exclusive equipment and ultimate skills are obtained and learned through the main story

  • New Skin: Azure Wolf

Includes character illustration / combat model / overworld appearance

How do I install the DLC?

The DLC must be installed manually. In your Steam Library, select Three Kingdoms Mushouden, click DLC under the Play button, then download the DLC you want to access it in game.

New Gameplay Feature: Subdue Generals

Three new special tools for capturing enemy generals have been added:
Grappling Hook, Horse Snare, and Serpent Bind.

These tools can be obtained from Noble Armories, Bandit Armories, City Markets, and Chronicle quests. Use them in battle to capture generals you desire.

After successfully capturing a general, you may choose to recruit them, release them, execute them—or squeeze some extra profit from your prisoner. The choice is yours.

General Fixes

  • Optimized overall system performance

Thank you once again for your continued support! We will continue to closely monitor community feedback. If you encounter any issues after the update, feel free to contact us on Discord.

zh.bodyHtml:
猛将们，久等了。

此前，我们曾向大家承诺，将为《猛将三国》推出更加完整、更加深入的武将传记内容。

经过一段时间的调试，今天，我们终于可以正式向大家宣布——

张辽、关羽的大型免费扩展包将于 12 月 25 日 正式上线

其中，将包含张辽、关羽两位武将的专属装备、全新奥义、全新皮肤，以及即将一同登场的重要更新：适用于所有模式的「降服武将」玩法。

感谢每一位猛将一直以来的支持与等待，大家在这段时间给予了我们很多支持与鼓励、也提出了许多宝贵的批评和建议。我们修复了不少问题，但也清楚，《猛将三国》仍然有许多需要持续改进的地方。

《猛将三国》是我们工作室的第一部买断制作品，能走到今天，完全是因为大家的热爱与支持。而现在，正是我们回馈大家的时刻。

同时，《猛将三国》也在参与steam冬季特卖活动，游戏本体 与 游戏豪华版，均已开启 8折优惠，折扣预计将在1月6日结束。如果您正准备初入乱世，现在或许正是一个不错的时机。

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3285500/_/

未来更新内容一览

关羽DLC扩展包

《猛将三国·关羽传》 为游戏本体《猛将三国》的传记扩展包。内含关羽专属装备、奥义、新皮肤，并新增「降服武将」玩法。

龙跃于渊

有些人天生就是英雄，但更多人相信，英雄曾经也只是个凡人。从乡野武夫到华夏武圣，千古流芳的背后，经历了一段怎样的蜕变？这一段“龙跃于渊”的传奇，就在本篇传记之中。

传记专属内容

青龙探海

  • 关羽专属装备：长刀、战甲、头盔

飞龙在天

  • 关羽全新奥义 · 忠义无双

见龙在田

  • 关羽全新皮肤 · 武圣。包含立绘、战斗造型、大世界造型

张辽DLC扩展包

《猛将三国·张辽传》 同样为游戏本体《猛将三国》的传记扩展包。内含张辽专属装备、奥义、新皮肤，并新增「降服武将」玩法。

胡汉风云

古人常言：非我族类，其心必异。然而真正的英雄，所求者乃是——天下归心。

本篇传记将带领大家，走进一个渴望证明自己的懵懂少年，看他如何立志成为能让天下归心的英雄豪杰。

传记专属内容

怒意威灵

  • 张辽专属装备：长戟、战甲、头盔

所向披靡

  • 张辽全新奥义 · 苍狼啸月

雄姿英发

  • 张辽全新皮肤 · 苍狼。包含立绘、战斗造型、大世界造型

另外，本次更新，我们还为大家带来了新玩法：「降服武将」玩法，该玩法除了即将登场的张辽、关羽传记之外，所有模式均可使用。

重要更新：全新「降服武将」玩法

新增三种生擒武将所需的特殊装备：挠钩、绊马索、蛇骨缠。

您可以通过豪族武库、匪寨武库、城市市场、传记任务等途径获取生擒武将所需的装备，并在战斗中利用这些装备来生擒您心仪的武将。

生擒武将后，您可以选择将之收归麾下，亦可以将之释放或斩首，另外，还可以从俘虏身上“捞点油水”。如何处置，全在您一念之间。

12 月 25 日，乱世再启

新的传记，新的抉择，新的可能。

《猛将三国》张辽、关羽扩展包将在12月25日正式上线，还请大家与我们一同期待！

BUG＆意见反馈

如果您除了以上问题之外，还有超有趣的想法及建议，都非常欢迎点击此处/前往官群告诉我们，我们都会持续关注的！

en.title: Update Preview | Guan Yu & Zhang Liao Free Expansion Coming Soon!
en.summary: Greetings, warriors! Previously, we promised to deliver deeper and more complete character biography content for Three Kingdoms Mushouden. After a period of development and polishi…
en.bodyHtml:
Greetings, warriors!

Previously, we promised to deliver deeper and more complete character biography content for Three Kingdoms Mushouden.

After a period of development and polishing, we are excited to officially announce—

The large free expansion packs for Guan Yu and Zhang Liao will launch on December 25!

This update includes exclusive equipment, brand-new ultimate abilities, and new character skins for both generals,along with a major system update arriving at the same time:the “Capture Generals” system, available across all game modes.

Thank you to every warrior for your continued support and patience.

During this time, you’ve given us encouragement, valuable feedback, and honest criticism.
While we’ve fixed many issues, we know there is still much room for improvement.

Three Kingdoms Mushouden is our studio’s very first premium (buy-to-play) title.The fact that it has come this far is entirely thanks to your passion and support.And now, it’s time for us to give something back.

At the same time, Three Kingdoms Mushouden is participating in the Steam Winter Sale.Both the Base Game and Deluxe Edition are available at 20% off,with the sale expected to end on January 6.

If you’re about to step into this era of chaos for the first time, now might be the perfect moment.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3285500/_/

Upcoming Content Overview

Guan Yu DLC Expansion

Three Kingdoms Mushouden · The Tale of Guan Yu

This biography expansion for the base game includes
Guan Yu’s exclusive equipment, new ultimate ability, new skin,
and introduces the Capture Generals system.

Biography Content

Exclusive equipment: Blade, Armor, Helmet

New Ultimate: Oath of Loyalty

New Skin: Saint of War
(Illustration, battle model, and overworld appearance)

Zhang Liao DLC Expansion

Another biography expansion for the base game, featuringexclusive equipment, new ultimate ability, new skin,and the Capture Generals system.

Biography Content

Exclusive equipment: Halberd, Armor, Helmet

New Ultimate: Howl of the Cang Wolf

New Skin: Cang Wolf
(Illustration, battle model, and overworld appearance)

Major Update: Capture Generals System

This update also introduces a brand-new gameplay system:
Capture Generals, usable in all game modes, not just the new biographies.

  • Three special capture tools added:
    Grappling Hook / Horse Snare / Serpent Bind

  • Obtainable via Noble Armories, Bandit Camps, City Markets, and Biography Quests

  • Use these tools in battle to capture enemy generals alive

After capturing a general, you may choose to:
Recruit them, release them, execute them, or extract additional rewards
The decision is entirely yours.

December 25 — Chaos Begins Anew

New stories. New choices. New possibilities.
The Guan Yu & Zhang Liao Free Expansion launches December 25. Stay tuned!

Bug Reports & Feedback

If you have additional ideas or suggestions, feel free to share them with us on Discord!
